scope: One controlled boot_a-only V32 diagnostic trial under Noob's Linux-trial authorization. V32 derives from the V29 image that reached SSH twice and keeps its stock kernel and exact supplementary payload. Only primary /init changes: capture PID 1 guard stderr and retry at most two times after a clean guard refusal. The general thermal hold stays active for other images.
required_before_write: Fresh Fastboot identity, slot, partition size and download limit; exact V32/V19/stock hashes; offline validation and fixture receipts; current cool phone; a ready pinned collector; and verified V19 rollback.
required_after_reboot: Unplug USB, prove pinned SSH, start and verify V31 RAM health within the fresh-boot window, then arm Alpine only after live guard passes. Capture the PID 1 stderr log and boot log if the handoff refuses. If health or SSH fails, do not arm OpenRC.
abort_conditions: Unexpected identity, slot, write or reboot response; phone warming; charger connected during native boot; stale or failed health; unexplained SSH loss; unexpected recovery behavior; or any partial Alpine mount after a refusal.
